Priya G.: Quick note 10m: we'll run a short test that defers assignment for up to 20s to wait for enrichment. Canary = 15% inbound.
Noah R.: Important: if enrichment doesn't finish, fallback to Overflow RR and tag fallback_reason=ENRICH_TIMEOUT.
Clara S.: HubSpot workflow snippet for docs:
```
Trigger: Contact created
Delay: 20s
If: property(enriched)==true -> smart assign owner
Else -> assign queue Overflow RR; set property(fallback_reason)=ENRICH_TIMEOUT; set property(source)=canary
```
SDR Oncall: SDRs prepped. We'll pause automated drips for canary leads until owner confirmed.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow "Canary 20s Enrich Handoff" created by Noah R. (ID: 31245)
Priya G.: Observability: watch assign_latency_p95 and fallback_rate. Alert if fallback_rate > 0.12 for 10m. I'll host a 15m post-check.
Noah R.: Rolling flag in 5m. Tagging @here before go.
Clara S.: Added docs note about SF mapping: set Fallback_Flag__c=true on fallback so attribution stays consistent.
Priya G.: Thanks team. Keep replies minimal during the run so alerts are visible.
